changes: Added registered-main-worktree resolution for DONE and done_recover. DONE preflight now checks the actual worktree that owns branch main, keeps fail-before-write behavior for unsafe states, and uses that same worktree for merge/cleanup. Added focused smoke coverage for clean DONE, separate registered main DONE, separate registered main done_recover, wrong-branch rejection, and dirty-main rejection.
usage: Run lattice story_advance --storyId=<id> --phase=DONE from a story worktree as before. If branch main is checked out in another registered worktree, Lattice now resolves that worktree automatically. Use lattice done_recover --storyId=<id> for partial-DONE recovery.
expectedOutcome: DONE succeeds on a clean main target, uses a separate registered main worktree when branch main is owned elsewhere, and fails before phase mutation when the merge target is wrong-branch or dirty.
actualTranscript: Build passed. done-preflight-smoke printed PASS for happy path, separate registered main worktree, done_recover separate registered main worktree, wrong-branch fail-before-write, and dirty-main fail-before-write. worktree-authority-smoke passed. Process fact contract verified. validate reported 9/9 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No functional difference between expected and actual; reviewer notes were advisory only.
limitations: none - fully covered by isolated git smoke tests and validation evidence
pitfalls: The initial Claude Code implementation missed the done_recover registered-main scenario, so supervisor follow-up added the helper and recovery smoke. Scope gate also required explicit acknowledgement for the focused smoke file even though the intended glob covered done task files.
